_note: Build options of the owner-approved vanilla-reference drafts (pvan2 SV13 and SV14 finals, 'the new standard'): vtop vsolve options (amp, drive, afr, lift, roll, dz, dx, ms, sa) of the raised and lowered builds and the post-seat scale s of the lowered overlay. ga drafts top --from-vanilla builds a pinned id from these instead of solving, so the finals reproduce byte for byte (rules.json A1). raised_opts: the options of the raised build where they differ from the lowered one (SV13: lift 0.19 raised, 0.18 lowered).
